# WordPress Skills

> WordPress skills for Claude Code and Codex.
> Focus: plugin review, WooCommerce, security, performance, REST API, migrations, testing, WP-CLI ops, Playground, and PHPStan.

## Primary pages
- Homepage: https://jorgerosal.github.io/wordpress-skills/
- Repository: https://github.com/jorgerosal/wordpress-skills

## High-intent workflow guides
- How to review a WooCommerce extension with Claude Code: https://jorgerosal.github.io/wordpress-skills/guides/review-woocommerce-extension-with-claude-code.html
- WordPress release engineering checklist for Claude Code: https://jorgerosal.github.io/wordpress-skills/guides/wordpress-release-engineering-checklist.html

## What this repository contains
- Claude Code plugin skills for WordPress code review
- Parallel Codex skill wrappers for the same WordPress domains
- Slash commands for full reviews and quick triage
- WordPress-specific review heuristics, examples, and reference docs

## Common tasks
- Review a WordPress plugin for security or performance issues
- Audit a WooCommerce extension for HPOS compatibility and checkout risk
- Review REST API permission callbacks and schema handling
- Check migrations, WP-CLI commands, PHPStan setup, and release readiness
- Turn findings into a test plan before shipping

## Best starting commands
- `/wordpress-skills:wp-plugin-review [path]`
- `/wordpress-skills:wp-woo-review [path]`
- `/wordpress-skills:wp-sec-review [path]`
- `/wordpress-skills:wp-perf-review [path]`
- `/wordpress-skills:wp-migration-review [path]`
- `/wordpress-skills:wp-ops-review [path]`
- `/wordpress-skills:wp-phpstan-review [path]`
- `/wordpress-skills:wp-test-review [path]`
